topIssues.title: fix(op-service/eth): Blob.UnmarshalText uses wrong hexutil label (Bytes32)
topIssues.author: cuiweixie
topIssues.body:
## Problem

`(*Blob).UnmarshalText` calls `hexutil.UnmarshalFixedText` with `"Bytes32"` even though `Blob` is a large fixed-size type (EIP-4844 blob), not 32 bytes. Error messages and validation can mislead callers.

## Expected

Use a type name consistent with `Blob`, e.g. `"Blob"`.

## PR

Tracked in the linked pull request.

topIssues.title: fix(op-service): CachingReceiptsProvider leaks fetching lock on FetchReceipts error
topIssues.author: cuiweixie
topIssues.body:
## Problem

`CachingReceiptsProvider.FetchReceipts` registers a per-block mutex in `fetching` and removes it after a successful fetch. If `inner.FetchReceipts` returns an error, the code returned without `deleteFetchingLock`, leaving the map entry (and mutex) behind indefinitely.

## Expected

Remove the fetching lock for the block hash on error, same as on success.

## PR

Tracked in the linked pull request.

topIssues.title: fix(kona/protocol): span batch gas decode errors reported as TxNonces
topIssues.author: cuiweixie
topIssues.body:
## Problem

`decode_tx_gases` maps unsigned varint decode failures to `SpanDecodingError::TxNonces`, which mislabels gas-limit decoding errors.

## Expected

- Add `SpanDecodingError::TxGases` for gas varint decode failures.
- Use it in `decode_tx_gases`.

## PR

Tracked in the linked pull request.

topPRs.title: fix(kona/derive): use walked-back system config on pipeline reset
topPRs.author: sebastianst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Fixes the pipeline initialization bug where kona used the system config from the L2 safe head during reset, instead of the system config from the walked-back L2 block whose L1 origin is `channel_timeout` blocks behind. If the batcher address changes within that window, derivation diverges from op-node.

**Issue:** ethereum-optimism/optimism-private#452

### Changes

- **`DerivationPipeline::initial_reset()`** — New method implementing op-node's `initialReset` L2 walkback algorithm. Walks back L2 parents until the L1 origin is at most `channel_timeout` blocks behind the safe head's L1 origin, producing both the correct L1 origin and system config from the same block.

- **`StageReset` trait** — Replaces internal `SignalReceiver` usage on stages with direct method calls (`reset`, `activate`, `flush_channel`, `provide_block`).

- **`activate()` is a parameterless soft reset** — Clears buffered channels and batches but preserves derivation state (origin, epoch tracking, system config). No walkback, no parameters. Batch stages override to skip epoch clearing.

- **Simplified `Signal` types** — `ResetSignal` and `ActivationSignal` now only carry `l2_safe_head`. No optional fields, no `l1_origin`, no `system_config`. The pipeline is the single authority for computing these on reset.

- **Traversal stages** resolve `BlockNumHash` → `BlockInfo` via their `ChainProvider` during reset.

- **`BatchQueue`/`BatchValidator`** read origin from `OriginProvider` after reset propagation, not from signal parameters.

- **Removed redundant walkback** from `Engine::reset()` (node). Simplified return type to `L2BlockInfo`.

## Test plan

- [x] 3 new unit tests for `initial_reset()`: walkback with batcher change, genesis boundary, zero timeout
- [x] All 210 existing kona-derive tests pass
- [x] `cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings` clean
- [x] `cargo check --all-features` clean across all affected crates
- [x] Nightly `rustfmt` clean
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] Follow-up: `op-e2e/actions/proofs` test for batcher change within channel_timeout (stacked branch)

topPRs.title: fix(op-node): bypass event system for sequencer→engine path
topPRs.author: sebastianst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Eliminates 200ms+ ForkchoiceUpdate-with-attributes delays during batch derivation by having the sequencer call engine methods directly instead of going through the event system. This makes reliable flashblock production at 1s block times feasible.

**Root cause:** The event system uses a synchronous drain loop with no preemption. The sequencer timer fires mid-drain but cannot be serviced until `Drain()` returns, causing 200ms+ delays in the FCU+attrs call that starts block building. The sequencer-engine interaction is a tight request-response pattern (6+ event hops per block) shoehorned into a broadcast event system designed for loose coupling.

**Fix:** Bypass the event system for the latency-critical sequencer-engine path:
- Add `StartBuild`, `SealBuild`, `ProcessPayload` direct-call methods to `EngineController`
- Extract internal methods (`startBuild`, `sealBuild`, `processNewPayload`, `finalizePayload`) that event handlers delegate to
- Define `SequencerEngine` interface in sequencing package
- Sequencer calls engine directly for block production (zero event round-trips)
- Event system continues to handle derivation path unchanged
- Add pre-drain `sequencerCh` check + High priority driver emitter as safety net
- Define `ErrPayloadDenied`, `ErrPayloadInvalid` sentinel errors

### What changes

| Component | Change |
|-----------|--------|
| `engine/build_results.go` | New file: `BuildStartResult`, `SealResult` types |
| `engine/build_start.go` | Extract `startBuild()`, add `StartBuild()` public method |
| `engine/build_seal.go` | Extract `sealBuild()`, add `SealBuild()` public method |
| `engine/payload_process.go` | Extract `processNewPayload()`, `finalizePayload()`, add `ProcessPayload()` public method |
| `engine/payload_success.go` | `onPayloadSuccess` delegates to `finalizePayload()` |
| `sequencing/engine_iface.go` | New file: `SequencerEngine` interface |
| `sequencing/sequencer.go` | Direct calls replace event emissions for build/seal/process |
| `driver/driver.go` | Pre-drain sequencerCh check, High priority driver emitter |
| `op-e2e/.../l2_sequencer.go` | Updated drain points: `ForkchoiceUpdateEvent`, `UnsafeUpdateEvent` |

### What doesn't change

- Derivation path (event system, all event handlers, `OnEvent` dispatch table)
- `BuildCancelEvent` still event-based (rare, not latency-critical)
- Error events still emitted by engine methods (for non-sequencer listeners)
- Informational events (`ForkchoiceUpdateEvent`, `UnsafeUpdateEvent`) still emitted

Closes #19263

## Test plan

- [x] `go build ./op-node/...` compiles
- [x] `go vet ./op-node/...` passes
- [x] `go test ./op-node/rollup/engine/... -count=1` passes
- [x] `go test ./op-node/rollup/sequencing/... -count=1` passes (incl. 99 chaos simulations)
- [x] `go test ./op-node/rollup/driver/... -count=1` passes
- [x] `go build ./op-e2e/...` compiles
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] Manual verification with builder-playground + `--batcher-max-channel-duration 50`
